rootOpenNote.note: The registered P2CG1F behaviour text names CF13, the CF12 consumer half, CF14 (as "bumps loadGeneration in adoptFlushedRevision, or refuses a guarded adoption whose version is older than baseVersion") and the m7, m8 and m12 pins, but not the CF-F3 pre-receipt quiet window the unit ships: one APPLICATION_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT_MS (60 s) timer armed per bound binding, cleared by the first campaign frame, by rejoin and by dispose, which the admission absorbed from the P2CG1E review carry-forward CF-F3 (review section 2 item 3 and section 6 item 1). Part (b) is recorded here: of the two CF14 options the text offers, P2CG1F took the loadGeneration bump in adoptFlushedRevision, placed after the response.ok, version and envelope-digest proofs (review section 2 item 4 and section 6 item 2, which rules the bump the better of the two); the guarded-adoption refusal was not implemented. For part (a), a parent documentary correction of P2CG1F's behaviour text follows as a separate PR, as #2230 did for E-DOC-1. This closure does not edit P2CG1F's behaviour text (own-lifecycle authority does not cover it); the correction is documentary and changes no reviewed behaviour or proof recorded here.

entries.before: Eighth narrower P2CG1 successor: surface preparation for creator binding, still legacy on the wire. M2/CF11 is decided at registration: the host fold moves to a module-scoped store, the new src/lib/campaign/coop/campaignHostFoldStore.ts, like the guest mirror. A host rebind on a live bound transport then continues the lineage instead of starting from EMPTY, and retainsLaunchFacts is kept. m13: the surface's refusal and projection helpers move to the new src/components/campaign/coop/campaignCoopSurfaceHelpers.ts, so the surface stays under the max-lines warning before binding grows it. Three surface suites register hand-built fake transports without campaignId (CampaignLifecycleGate, GuestProposalSurface, GuestRebuildStaleGate). Their fakes get the mounted campaignId, because connectStoredCampaignSyncTransport returns null for an existing transport whose campaignId differs from expectedCampaignId, so P2CG1G2's binding would otherwise detach them. hostProjection registers the P2CF2 m8 P1 case (rebind on a live bound transport) with the store behaviour. No creator binds expectedCampaignId here. Planned leaves (7): src/components/campaign/coop/CampaignCoopRouteSurfaceConnected.tsx, src/components/campaign/coop/campaignCoopSurfaceHelpers.ts (new), src/lib/campaign/coop/campaignHostFoldStore.ts (new), and under src/components/campaign/coop/__tests__/ the suites CampaignCoopRouteSurfaceConnected.hostProjection.test.tsx, CampaignLifecycleGate.test.tsx, GuestProposalSurface.test.tsx and GuestRebuildStaleGate.test.tsx. Estimated at about 160-240 counted lines with lifecycle (moved helper lines count again); that is not a cap-fit proof.
